correct_orders: Laboratory tests: Complete blood count (CBC), coagulation panel, thyroid function tests, and hormone levels
Imaging studies: Transvaginal ultrasound, pelvic MRI
should_avoid: Order for immediate dilation and curettage (D&C) as it may be premature without definitive diagnosis

rationale.Laboratory tests: Complete blood count (: Laboratory testing when systemic illness or severity warrants labs in this diagnosis.
rationale.Imaging studies: Transvaginal ultrasound: Pelvic/cervical evaluation is central for this diagnosis and localizes the source of heavy menstrual bleeding.
rationale.β-hCG: Appropriate CCS order for this diagnosis: β-hCG.
rationale.Order for immediate dilation and curetta: CCS review: avoid this order for this diagnosis — it does not change acute management.
